30A Escapes presents… “Wave N Sea”, your personal slice of coastal luxury. Nestled in the prestigious, gated Water’s Edge community in Seacrest Beach, this 4-bedroom, 3-bath retreat comfortably sleeps 12 and is thoughtfully designed to blend laid-back beach living with elevated comfort. Just steps from private beach access, this home is a dream for families and friends seeking sunshine, serenity, and style. Whether you are sipping wine on the balcony with Gulf breezes, sunbathing beside your private seasonally heated pool, or biking to nearby Rosemary or Alys Beach, every moment at “Wave N Sea” is effortlessly unforgettable. Learn more below…👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Luxury Gated Community – Located in the exclusive Water’s Edge next to Rosemary Beach
✔ Private Beach Access – Just steps away via a deeded path
✔ Seasonal Beach Chair Setup: Includes 2 chairs and 1 umbrella, available March 6 - October 31.
✔ Private Pool – Seasonally heated with pool loungers and al fresco dining
✔ Outdoor Living – Two furnished balconies and a spacious pool deck with gas grill
✔ 4 Bedrooms and 3 Bathrooms – Sleeps up to 12 with stylish and spacious accommodations
✔ Chef’s Kitchen – Stainless appliances, bar seating, and dining for 8
✔ 6 Bikes Included – Explore the best of 30A with ease

★☆ LIVING AREA ☆★

On the main level, the open-concept living space invites relaxation with cozy coastal furnishings and direct access to the pool deck. Whether you are enjoying family movie night or gathering after the beach, this space is designed for connection and comfort.

✔ Plush sofa and seating for the whole group
✔ Large flat-screen TV for streaming or movies
✔ Double doors open to the pool deck for seamless indoor/outdoor living

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

Stylish and functional, the kitchen is perfect for whipping up post-beach snacks or full family feasts. Enjoy stainless steel appliances, plenty of prep space, and dining areas made for memory-making.

✔ Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances
✔ Bar seating for 4 at the island for casual bites or wine chats
✔ Dining table seats 8 for family-style meals and evening games

★☆ OUTDOOR OASIS ☆★

With multiple outdoor living areas to choose from, you will love lounging by the private pool, hosting cookouts on the grill, or sipping morning coffee on the breezy balconies. Whether it is sun-soaked afternoons or star-lit evenings, this outdoor space is made for unforgettable moments.

✔ Private seasonally heated pool with sun loungers and outdoor shower
✔ Al fresco dining for 6 on the pool deck—perfect for laid-back meals
✔ Gas grill for cookouts with your crew
✔ 2nd Floor Balcony – Furnished for morning coffee or sunset wine
✔ 3rd Floor Balcony – Private space off the bunk room with views and breezes

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

1st Floor
✔ Queen Guest Suite – Two Queen beds, flat-screen TV, and en-suite bathroom with single vanity and walk-in shower

2nd Floor
✔ Queen Guest Suite – Queen bed, flat-screen TV, and balcony access
✔ Guest Bathroom – Shared hall bath with single vanity and walk-in shower
✔ Primary King Suite – King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access, and spa-style en-suite with dual vanities, soaking tub, and walk-in shower
✔ Laundry Room – Full-size washer and dryer

3rd Floor
✔ Bunk Room – Two Twin-over-Full bunk beds, flat-screen TV, private balcony access

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Tucked inside the gated Water’s Edge community, Wave N Sea is perfectly situated just steps from the sand and moments from 30A’s most beloved destinations.

✔ Steps to private beach access – No crowded boardwalks here
✔ 6-minute walk to Rosemary Beach – Boutiques, dining, and town charm
✔ 13-minute walk to Alys Beach – Renowned architecture and events
✔ Close to Peddler’s Pavilion – Seasonal live music and casual eats
✔ Bike-friendly paths throughout the area—ride your way to adventure

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 6 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.
✔ Pool can be heated between September 1st and April 30th
✔ This property has 1 complimentary beach set-up available 3/6 to 10/31, including 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.
✔ To see a virtual tour of this home, please visit https://www.insidemaps.com/app/walkthrough-tour/?p=eZYALZDkQe&embedded=true

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Rosemary Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach. Frank Brown Park is a popular attraction and the area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Sundog Books and Emerald Coast Mirror Maze are also worth visiting. Swimming offers a great chance to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
